<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW266b2wAzfAJMBjD5JpGuLWE)_

## Merge order

- Independent; merge any time.
- **Includes #512.** #512 was merged into the branch of #510, not into `main`, so the Caps+Option+number colour keys never reached `main`. This PR carries them, with the redo on top.

## What changes

- `Cmd+Shift+Z` runs Edit > Redo only when its title says highlight, annotation or markup (e.g. "Redo Add Highlight"). Otherwise the normal Cmd+Shift+Z goes to DEVONthink.
- It mirrors `Cmd+Z`: the Edit menu always shows the next redo step, so a stale or already-redone highlight is never touched.
- Only active while DEVONthink is in front.
- Also from #512, now landing on `main`:
  - `Caps+Option+1` to `7` pick Red, Green, Blue, Yellow, Orange, Purple, Grey and start highlighting.
  - `Caps+Option+Shift+1` to `7` only set the colour.
  - `aerospace-keys.lua` opens the Caps layer when Option is already held.

## Manual testing

- [ ] Reload Hammerspoon: no error in the console.
- [ ] Make a highlight, press Cmd+Z: it disappears. Press Cmd+Shift+Z: it comes back.
- [ ] Open the Edit menu after Cmd+Z: note the Redo title. If it does not mention highlight, send me `DEVONthink.dumpMenu("Edit")`.
- [ ] Press Cmd+Shift+Z with nothing to redo: normal DEVONthink behaviour, no error.
- [ ] Undo a highlight, then do another action, then Cmd+Shift+Z: the highlight is not brought back.
- [ ] Caps+Option+1 to 7 pick the colours; Caps+c still cycles; Caps+3 alone still switches workspace.
- [ ] In other apps, Cmd+Z and Cmd+Shift+Z behave as usual.

---
